messages:
maria: FYI repro for KV divergence when we clone shards mid-warmstart. Short summary + steps below.

maria: Symptoms: after reclone, outputs start matching then at token ~1200 they diverge; int4 and int8 both show but int4 worse.

anya: Can you paste the minimal repro? :thinking: 

derek: also saw this in nightly - might be proactive reclone path.

maria: repro steps:
```
# run reproducer
./repro/run.sh --model magnet13b-q4_0 --seed 42 --prefill 1024 --steps 1500 --reclone-after 800 --log-kv
```
```
# quick check
sha256sum out/kv_snapshot.bin  # expected: a1b2c3... (seen mismatch)
```

maria: sample mismatch log:
```
[KV] idx=1198 token=582 -> kv_hash=0x7f1a
[KV] idx=1199 token=34  -> kv_hash=0x7f1a
[KV] idx=1200 token=77  -> kv_hash=0x9b2c  <-- diverged
```

kevin: interesting. does disabling prefetch avoid the divergence?

maria: disabling prefetch (+--no-prefetch) makes it more stable but still flaky on int4. int8 seems ok.

sam: possible causes: ropen scaling mismatch on clone, or copy-on-write race when KV pages remap. Did you try forcing full memcpy instead of remap?

maria: yes: `--force-memcopy` reduces incidence by ~90% in our small runs.

infra-bot: deploy-log: reclone job 2026-07-15T12:34Z started on shard-13

anya: can we compare the KV keys and rotary phase vectors pre/post clone? If rotary phase mis-apply we'll see a phase shift causing divergence.

maria: attached quick dumps: kv_keys_pre.bin -> sha256: abcde12345, kv_keys_post.bin -> sha256: abcde123f5 (off by one byte). Looks like an alignment padding issue.

derek: guess: quantized int4 packing means padding bytes used for alignment and a remap that doesn't preserve padding leads to shift. Logging this as hypothesis.

maria: next steps: create unit test that reclones with different alignment offsets, run across int8,int4,int3 builds, record kv_hash and out_text diffs.

kevin: can we triage under eng-runtime? marking @eng-runtime and @eng-ml for pairing tomorrow.

anya: ACK. I'll schedule a pairing slot 10:30 PST. 

maria: thanks all. I pushed reproducer at github.com/redwood/repro/kv-reclone with small doc and a small dataset. TL;DR: prefilling + reclone exposes rotor/padding alignment bug in int4.

sam: adding note to long-context eval board: potential quality regression for longprefill scenarios with quantized models.

maria: closing notes: if you run the repro, capture kv_dump.bin and run `tools/kv-checksum.py kv_dump.bin` and paste checksum in thread. :memo:

kevin: i'll run later and paste checksums.

maria: thanks :pray:
